title: The coaches want an extra session
text: A heavy week on the track, or a week to freshen up?

choices.label: Heavy session
choices.result: A heavy week on the track. The legs will know about it on game day.

choices.label: Recovery week
choices.result: A recovery week: fresher bodies and minds.

title: {name} is pushing for games
text: The kid's flying at training and wants a senior game.

choices.label: Back him for {run_games} games
choices.note: Nothing develops a player like AFL footy.

choices.label: A week with the development coaches
choices.note: It doesn't take a spot in the side, but there's no game for him at all this week.
choices.result: {name} spends the week with the development coaches.
